name: 15851 · Reynoldsville, PA
findings: ZIP 15851 (Reynoldsville) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15851 (Reynoldsville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
